en: The postcard shows a black-and-white historic photograph of a church with a tall steeple and a cross on top, identified as the Trinitatiskirche (Trinity Church), along with a residential building to the right set on a slight rise, separated from the street by fencing. The image has some red-printed text detailing the location: Riesa a. Elbe, Trinitatiskirche, and credits the publisher Brück & Sohn in Meissen.
